sub_strands.name: Variance and Project Management Networks
performance_indicators: Calculate standard deviation and variance metrics to analyze performance inconsistencies in sports or design outputs.
Map optimal production paths using critical path method (CPM) network diagrams under deadline parameters.

sub_strands.name: Perspective Renderings and Product Prototyping
performance_indicators: Execute precise two-point and three-point perspective renderings of complex architectural subjects.
Construct functional product packaging blueprints incorporating die-lines, structural support tabs, and graphic assets.
Develop dynamic relief sculptures utilizing mixed media elements (plaster, wood, recycled synthetics) cleanly.

sub_strands.name: Industrial Revolution to Digital Art Paradigms
performance_indicators: Trace the design shifts from the Industrial Revolution up to the integration of modern digital layout programs.
Evaluate the aesthetic merits of local contemporary graphic installations using formal critiquing matrices.

sub_strands.name: Chromatic Modulations and Orchestration
performance_indicators: Transpose complex musical themes between closely related keys using accurate accidental alterations.
Arrange multi-part instrumental works incorporating distinct woodwind and percussion sections.
Execute advanced solo performances on a chosen instrument, observing strict expressive dynamic marks.

sub_strands.name: Script Editing, Lighting Design, and Ensembles
performance_indicators: Deconstruct a full-length dramatic script to configure character subtexts and overarching directorial concepts.
Code complex automated lighting scripts that change dynamically based on actors' blocking prompts.
Choreograph narrative dance ensemble pieces matching intricate traditional percussion tempos with symbolic bodily postures.

sub_strands.name: Aerobic/Anaerobic Pathways and Cardiorespiratory Fitness
performance_indicators: Map the conversion of metabolic substrates during the ATP-CP, glycolytic, and oxidative energy phases.
Measure VO2 max thresholds and analyze cardiovascular adaptations during intense endurance workloads.
Formulate specialized, periodized microcycle training schedules aimed at specific athletic performance targets.

sub_strands.name: Arousal Regulation and Movement Biomechanics
performance_indicators: Apply psychological interventions (e.g., progressive muscle relaxation, imagery) to regulate competition anxiety.
Analyze joint angles and linear angular velocity profiles during complex movements like a tennis serve.

sub_strands.name: Screenplays and Critical Aesthetics
performance_indicators: Compose original television screenplays incorporating technical camera direction cues and audio layouts.
Draft aesthetic evaluations of complex multi-genre performances using precise domain-specific critical frameworks.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Michezo ya Redio na Uhakiki wa Usanii
performance_indicators: Kuandika michezo ya redio inayotumia vionjo vya sauti na ishara za kimazingira kwa ufasaha.
Kutathmini makala ya kisanii ya waandishi wengine na kutoa ukosoaji wenye kujenga kiufundi.
